const demo=new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('demo')==='1';
function todayDay(){
 const d=new Date();
 if(d.getFullYear()!==2026 || d.getMonth()!==11) return d.getFullYear()>2026 ? 24 : 0;
 return Math.min(24,d.getDate());
}
const available=demo?24:todayDay();
document.querySelectorAll('.door').forEach(btn=>{
 const n=Number(btn.dataset.day);
 if(n>available){
   btn.classList.add('locked');
   btn.addEventListener('click',()=>alert(n<=24 && available===0 ? 'De adventskalender opent op 1 december 2026.' : 'Dit deurtje opent op '+n+' december.'));
 } else {
   btn.addEventListener('click',()=>openDay(n));
 }
});
function openDay(n){
 const d=days[n];
 document.getElementById('mday').textContent='DAG '+n+' • '+d.title;
 document.getElementById('mtitle').textContent='Een woord van hoop';
 document.getElementById('mref').textContent=d.ref;
 document.getElementById('mmsg').textContent=d.msg;
 document.getElementById('modal').classList.add('open');
}
function closeModal(){document.getElementById('modal').classList.remove('open')}
document.getElementById('modal').addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target.id==='modal')closeModal()});
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape')closeModal()});
